Named 3x1.5 m 4-6 kW model with price: chima.vn shows one price for all powers (1-4 kW) per listing - unusable; thangsauvn.com shows placeholder prices (1 ₫ / 100,000,000 ₫); automech.vn and goldenmicronvn give power-band ranges only (automech: 6 kW 1500x3000 '1.8 – 3.8 Tỷ'); TAT/Bodor dealer pages 'Giá liên hệ'. Haas Vietnam (haasvietnam.com, haasvn.com 522), MITAS (UMC-500 'Liên hệ'), WW Tech (DN DVF 5000, no price), TLT/automech ranges only ('2 tỷ đến 4.5 tỷ'). No award reachable. Only the chima.vn marketplace item above.

'máy đúc quay' / rotomolding: vinakingwell.com (3-arm rotomoulding machine, price $0.00 placeholder), xnktruongphat.com (no price), Chinese B2B (made-in-china/alibaba USD, not Vietnamese sellers).

Aluminium window machinery shops (tongkhomaysanxuatcuanhom.com - placeholder 10,000 ₫ prices; maysanxuatcua.com.vn, maynhom.vn - no price); no 6-7 m profile machining centre price.

New press: truongduong.vn (dealer, tonnages only), extruders' capacity pages (Kimsen, Tiến Đạt, FRAVI, Benrik, Việt Pháp Shal - no cost), searched HĐQT resolutions for 'máy ép đùn nhôm' - none found. Only the used auction lot above.
No generating gear grinder offered with a price on any Vietnamese site found (TAT gear category empty / 'Liên hệ').
'máy ép cao su 200 tấn' / lưu hóa: Trang Vàng listings without price; machineseeker.vn listings are European sellers, not Vietnamese.
